answer.reason: The verses tell two events of Agag: he was captured and spared by Saul, then killed by Samuel.

clauses.english: was taken alive and spared by Saul and the people
clauses.quote: But Saul and the people spared Agag

clauses.english: was hewed in pieces by Samuel before the LORD in Gilgal
clauses.quote: Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
